title: Date Range Picker
api:
interface DateRangePickerProps {
  value?: CalendarRange | null
  defaultValue?: CalendarRange | null
  onValueChange?: (value: CalendarRange) => void
  /** Submits two values: `${name}.start` and `${name}.end`. */
  name?: string
  startName?: string
  endName?: string
  form?: string
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  required?: boolean
  minDate?: Date
  maxDate?: Date
  disabled?: boolean
  loading?: boolean
  readOnly?: boolean
  locale?: string
  clearable?: boolean
  /** Display options for the shared calendar; range value and validation remain owned by this picker. */
  calendarOptions?: CalendarDisplayOptions
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  className?: string
  id?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
  'aria-labelledby'?: string
  'aria-describedby'?: string
  'aria-invalid'?: AriaAttributes['aria-invalid']
}

function DateRangePicker({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  name,
  startName,
  endName,
  form,
  label,
  placeholder: placeholderProp,
  required = false,
  minDate,
  maxDate,
  disabled = false,
  loading = false,
  readOnly = false,
  locale: localeProp,
  clearable = true,
  calendarOptions,
  size = 'md',
  className,
  id,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
  'aria-describedby': describedBy,
  'aria-invalid': invalid,
}: DateRangePickerProps);

props.name: calendarOptions
props.description: Display options for the shared calendar; range value and validation remain owned by this picker.

notes: A range is {start: Date|null, end: Date|null}; allow the intermediate state with only a start date.
name submits name.start and name.end. Do not substitute an array or shadcn’s from/to object.
